reden: Yes. The report explicitly flags “cancel() has no maker authorization: anyone can cancel any order,” noting cancel() only checks order.maker != 0 and doesn’t compare msg.sender with order.maker. This is the same flaw, same function, and same attack path as the described H-02. The same fix (require msg.sender == order.maker / revert Unauthorized) would resolve both. The description’s mention of combined issues (double refund) is ancillary; the core missing-authorization issue is detected.
